top_signals.title: Verizon Beats, Brazil in Focus | Stock Movers
top_signals.summary:
Today's biggest winners and losers in the stock market.

On this episode of Stock Movers:

- Verizon (VZ) shares are moving after it reported its strongest third-quarter performance in wireless customer additions in five years, adding a net 406,000 monthly phone lines.

- PagSeguro (PAGS) is among the many Brazil-linked stocks sliding this morning after President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva won Brazil’s runoff election with 51.8% of the vote, defeating Flávio Bolsonaro who received 48.2%.

- Surgery Partners (SGRY) is moving on news Bon Secours Mercy Health is in late-stage talks to buy a majority stake in Surgery Partners, the Financial Times reported. (Source: Bloomberg)
